summary: WebSocket-driven remote shell and filesystem control on the installer host
details: The package connects to a WebSocket server (configurable via SERVER_URL, defaulting to ws://localhost:3456 with a hardcoded default shared secret 'agent-shared-secret') and dispatches remote messages to handlers that spawn a PTY (bash/pwsh/cmd via process.env.SHELL) and write attacker-supplied bytes into that shell's stdin. The same message router forwards remote messages such as read_file, write_file, create_file, delete_files, move_files, copy_files, upload_to_dir, git_add, git_commit, and git_push to workbench handlers that operate directly on the host filesystem and local git repositories. Whoever controls the reachable WebSocket endpoint therefore has full command execution and file/repo mutation on the running host. Separately, on agent startup the package clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, runs 'git pull --ff-only' on subsequent starts against the mutable HEAD, copies content into the Claude plugin cache, writes known_marketplaces.json and installed_plugins.json, and enables the plugin in ~/.claude/settings.json. The clone source is publisher-matched (github.com/yeaft) but is not version-pinned.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
